descriptionEn: Collateral-free institutional micro-credit loans up to ₹10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises.
eligibilityDescEn: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity.
benefitEn: Loans up to ₹10,00,000 (Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories) without collateral
departmentEn: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

rules.messageEn: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
Applicant intends to establish or run micro-enterprise

descriptionEn: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme awarding scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropout rate at class VIII.
eligibilityDescEn: Students studying in Class IX with parental annual income not exceeding ₹3,50,000.
benefitEn: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for classes IX to XII
departmentEn: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education

rules.messageEn: Applicant must be a currently enrolled student
Annual family income must not exceed ₹3.5 Lakhs
